words.prose: {{ar:سَجَىٰ}} ({{tr:sajā}}) is the point where the night-oath settles. Its hidden masculine subject is {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}), so the genitive sworn witness becomes the one that reaches the state named by the verb. Under {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}), the perfect form gives a recurring completed threshold: whenever night has grown still. The Form I intransitive frame makes this a state night enters, not an action imposed on an object. Lexically, the selected force is calm settling and uniform stillness, not mere darkening; the covering branch survives as an undertone because the subject is night, but it is narrowed away from a transitive cloth-covering act. The sea-calm, steady-eye, and shroud images give the word concrete pressure: motion comes to rest, gaze stops darting, and cover lies over the scene. This completes the polarity with the exposed morning of 93:1 and also revoices the prior night-covering field (92:1) from active covering into settled calm. The verb is unusually load-bearing as the only Quranic occurrence of root {{ar:س ج و}} ({{tr:s-j-w}}), and the ayah lands on its open final vowel, so the sound closure participates in the extended stillness it names.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The night noun rooted ل ي ل is joined by إذا to a verb rooted س ج و, so the oath catches a transition rather than naming a static backdrop.
baseline_models.mechanism: Darkness supplies the field while motion in night, sea, wind, and gaze subsides together; the scene closes by becoming still.

activation_trace.role: Night opposed to day supplies the dark temporal field in which the transition occurs.
Still settling across night, water, wind, or gaze supplies the event of motion closing down.

changed_reading.after: An oath by the threshold at which night actively settles, closes in, and quiets a moving field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The س ج و verb can carry a cloth-covering image while its grammatical subject remains the night.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night behaves like a covering drawn across what was visible. The image retains an unresolved range from sheltering cloth to concealing shroud.

activation_trace.role: Night's darkness supplies the wide surface-like medium that can cover the visible world.
Draping a cloth, including a shroud, turns nocturnal darkening into a material act of covering.

changed_reading.after: Night draws itself over the scene like cloth, ambiguously concealing, sheltering, or shrouding it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ل ي ل inventory includes entering or acting by night, and the إذا clause gives that nocturnal mode a finite onset.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night is not only scenery but an operation: it arrives, takes up the field, and performs a settling upon it.

activation_trace.role: Entering or doing something by night supplies an active nocturnal mode rather than passive clock-time.
Settling and closing-in gives that nocturnal mode its operative effect on the surrounding field.

changed_reading.before: Night is the time during which something else might happen.
changed_reading.after: Night itself enters as an actor and performs the quieting of the scene.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A remote but explicit س ج و branch concerns abundant yielding from milk or a well, still attached to the focus verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dark settled surface can be imagined as a reservoir: apparent inactivity may conceal a supply not yet visible.

activation_trace.role: Night's opacity makes the quantity held beneath the settled scene unavailable to sight.
Abundant milk or well-water supplies the latent yield hidden inside the apparent stillness.

changed_reading.before: Settling means that activity and production have stopped.
changed_reading.after: Settling may be the quiet surface of a hidden abundance capable of yielding later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding daylight interval extends and emerges into visibility while night settles and closes. The paired oath therefore becomes a hinge between exposure and repose, not an isolated celebration of darkness.

activation_trace.role: Night as day's dark opposite supplies one side of the alternating temporal pair.
Settling and closing-in gives the nocturnal side its characteristic movement toward repose.
Daylight's extension supplies a temporal expansion against which nocturnal contraction becomes legible.
Emergence into sun and visibility supplies the exposed counterphase to night's closing cover.

structural_cues: 93:1 immediately precedes 93:2 as the first member of a coordinated two-part oath.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies daylight extension and exposure beside nocturnal settling; I infer a reversible rhythmic hinge. A live alternative is simple contrast with no cyclic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Night settles as a self-contained dark event.
changed_reading.after: Night's settling is the necessary counterphase of an exposure–repose rhythm whose other edge is daylight's emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah places repose beside explicitly negated abandonment and heart-distance, then names a relation of nurturing continuity. Nocturnal quiet is reclassified as held silence rather than withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Still settling supplies the silence whose relational meaning is under examination.
Repose and ease overlap with stillness, allowing quiet to be read without severance.
Leaving and releasing supplies the feared interpretation that the explicit negation blocks.
Nurturing, repair, and completion supply continuing work beneath the quiet interval.
Abiding continuity prevents the settled night from functioning as a terminal absence.
Heart-distance through aversion supplies a second withdrawal model that the coordinated negation excludes.

structural_cues: The coordinated double negation in 93:3 follows the nocturnal image and denies both departure and aversive distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quiet, denied leaving, denied heart-distance, and abiding nurture; I infer that 93:3 answers a possible misreading of 93:2. The night can alternatively remain only a cosmic sign.

changed_reading.before: The settling night can feel like contact has ceased.
changed_reading.after: The silence is a repose held inside continuing care: quiet is not evidence of departure or rejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, better, beginning, and succession put a vector through the settled scene. Night is no longer a closed endpoint but a delayed interval whose value may appear only in what follows it.

activation_trace.role: Settled closure supplies the apparently terminal state that the later sequence reopens.
Delay to a later time supplies duration beyond the present nocturnal closure.
Beneficial good assigns positive value to the sequel rather than merely chronological lateness.
Beginning and precedence supply the initial phase from which the settled interval can move.
The non-dominant mapped image of immediate succession supplies one phase following another without a void.

structural_cues: The comparative construction in 93:4 explicitly relates a later phase to an earlier one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delay, beneficial value, beginning, and succession; I infer that night is a transit with a favorable sequel. The alternative is a value comparison unrelated to the oath's temporal mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Settling closes the scene with no implied direction.
changed_reading.after: The closed scene is an interval with a vector: what is delayed can follow it closely and prove better.

context_deltas.mechanism: A future handover, nurturing completion, and resulting satisfaction revise the cloth-like cover. What is concealed under night can be undergoing preparation for a gift rather than being sealed away.

activation_trace.role: The drawn covering supplies an enclosed interval whose purpose remains initially ambiguous.
Handover and giving supply the eventual release of what the interval prepares.
Nurturing toward completion supplies active maturation beneath apparent concealment.
Acceptance opposed to discontent supplies the affective completion of the concealed process.
The effort to remove another's discontent makes the promised giving purposive and relational.

structural_cues: The future marker and result construction in 93:5 order giving before satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future giving, completion, and satisfaction; I supply the arrow that concealed time incubates the gift. A live alternative is a promise with no material relation to night's cover.

changed_reading.before: The night-cover hides or shrouds what lies beneath it.
changed_reading.after: The cover becomes incubative: hidden time can mature something that will later be handed over and received with satisfaction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Finding an isolated one and gathering that one into a merciful shelter selects the protective potential of the focus cover. The shroud-like ambiguity is not erased, but shelter becomes the stronger live direction.

activation_trace.role: The cloth-like cover supplies the material form that can either conceal a body or shelter it.
Encountering and locating supplies the first contact with one otherwise exposed or unheld.
Separation from a caretaker supplies the concrete vulnerability that makes covering protective.
Singularity without a counterpart widens orphanhood into the spatial condition of being alone.
Gathering into a shelter supplies the protective destination of the covering motion.
Tender mercy supplies the affective quality that distinguishes shelter from mere enclosure.

structural_cues: The sequence in 93:6 moves from found condition through vulnerability to a result introduced by fa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies isolation followed by gathering and mercy; I infer that the focus cover performs analogous shelter. The funereal potential of the same focus branch remains a live but weaker alternative.

changed_reading.before: Night draws an ambiguous cloth over the scene.
changed_reading.after: Night can be the canopy that gathers exposed singularity into shelter, not merely the cloth that hides it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Being found in hiddenness or lost direction and then guided gently activates a navigational reading. Nocturnal stillness becomes a low-noise field in which orientation can arrive without first abolishing darkness.

activation_trace.role: Darkness supplies the opacity in which a route or location is initially unavailable.
The quieting of motion supplies a receptive field for subtle orientation.
Finding and reaching the obscured one begins the transition from hiddenness to orientation.
Disappearance and hiddenness map the problem onto the night field rather than only moral error.
Missing the intended way supplies the directional problem that guidance resolves.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies orientation without a violent rupture of the scene.
Composed bearing and stillness let guidance resonate with, rather than cancel, the focus quiet.

structural_cues: The fa-linked transition in 93:7 moves directly from an obscured directional state to guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, missed direction, and gentle guidance; I infer that stillness enables perception of direction. The live alternative is that guidance simply terminates, rather than works within, the night image.

changed_reading.before: Night's opacity and stillness suspend movement.
changed_reading.after: The suspension can become a guidance chamber: direction is perceived quietly inside opacity before the dark field clears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence from encountered lack and poor nourishment to sufficiency selects the focus verb's abundant-yield branch. Night's still surface becomes reservoir-like: hidden supply answers depletion.

activation_trace.role: Abundant milk or well-water supplies a reservoir model latent inside the focus verb.
Capacity and material sufficiency link being found to the later reversal of want.
Poverty and need supply the empty state that makes a hidden yield consequential.
Poor nourishment gives the lack a bodily register answered by milk-like abundance.
Adequacy and sufficiency supply the completed state produced by the reservoir's release.

structural_cues: 93:8 repeats the found-state-result pattern and places lack immediately before a fa-marked sufficiency reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies depletion, nourishment failure, and sufficiency beside an explicit focus branch of abundant yield; I infer a hidden reservoir. The alternative is that the rare focus branch remains inert here.

changed_reading.before: The abundant-yield branch is an odd, unsupported possibility inside nocturnal stillness.
changed_reading.after: Night's stillness can conceal a well of provision whose delayed yield reverses embodied lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: A cover laid from above can shelter or press down. The vulnerable orphan and prohibition of domination, sharpened by the grinding-stone image, ethically specify the cover as a canopy that must not become crushing weight.

activation_trace.role: The laid cloth supplies an overhead cover whose pressure remains materially ambiguous.
Loss of a caretaker supplies the vulnerable person for whom cover must function as protection.
Domination from above supplies the social force that would convert shelter into subjugation.
A hard grinding stone supplies the material extreme of cover becoming crushing pressure.

structural_cues: The fa-amma partition and negative command in 93:9 turn remembered vulnerability into a present constraint on power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective covering, vulnerability, superior force, and grinding pressure; I infer an ethical test for how cover acts. The alternative is that the command has no backward material resonance.

changed_reading.before: Night's cloth covers the exposed one, with shelter and shroud still unresolved.
changed_reading.after: The acceptable cover is explicitly non-crushing: a canopy that protects vulnerability without using its position above to dominate.

context_deltas.mechanism: A request meets a prohibition of harsh silencing, while the same rebuke-root also carries opening and flowing images. Nocturnal quiet becomes receptive silence: it makes room for need to enter and flow instead of damming speech.

activation_trace.role: Settled quiet supplies the silence whose social function can be either receptive or suppressive.
Question and request supply the voice of need that tests what the quiet permits.
Harsh verbal rebuke supplies the rejected form of silence imposed by force.
Opening and widening until flow supplies the positive spatial alternative to rebuffing the request.

structural_cues: 93:10 repeats the fa-amma and negative-command frame of 93:9, but shifts the protected act from vulnerability to asking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request, rejected rebuke, and an opening-to-flow branch; I infer that quiet can listen and channel. The live alternative is that the flow image does not color the rebuke usage.

changed_reading.before: Settled night is silence because speech and movement have ceased.
changed_reading.after: Settled night models a listening aperture: quiet receives a request and lets need flow without being shouted shut.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good condition, abiding nurture, renewed speech, and manifestation turn concealment into a phase of trace-formation. The night-cover hides care temporarily; later telling draws its effects into public visibility.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the hidden interval whose contents are not yet available to public account.
A good transformed condition supplies the visible trace left by care during the hidden interval.
Softness and ease supply the gentle texture of the condition that emerges from concealment.
Abiding continuity supplies care that persists while it is unseen.
Speech renewed as news supplies the later verbal form taken by hidden experience.
Bringing something forth into view supplies the reversal from cover to manifestation.

structural_cues: The final imperative in 93:11 follows the remembered transformations and converts experienced condition into renewed speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden cover, enduring nurture, changed condition, renewed speech, and manifestation; I infer that concealment accumulates tellable traces. The alternative is a final reporting command unrelated to night.

changed_reading.before: Night's cover conceals and seals the scene.
changed_reading.after: The cover is temporary negative space in which care leaves traces that can later be manifested as testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a form-distant food idiom of not touching for an intransitive nocturnal verb. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch and gains ethical pressure from the later prohibitions against overpowering and rebuking vulnerable speech. Render only as an exploratory resonance of restraint, never as the direct lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The س ج و focus inventory explicitly preserves a non-touching or non-taking-hold branch.

activation_trace.role: Not touching or taking hold supplies a mode of settling through restraint rather than seizure.
Separation from a caretaker supplies the exposed other whose space must not be seized.
Domination from above supplies the prohibited grasp against which non-contact becomes ethical restraint.
A voiced request supplies the approach that quiet must receive without possessive taking.
Harsh rebuke supplies the verbal intrusion excluded by the restraint model.

changed_reading.before: Night settles by laying itself onto and taking possession of the scene.
changed_reading.after: Night may also settle by refraining from grasp: it leaves protected space around vulnerability and request.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the estate-tending branch is idiomatic and remote from ordinary nocturnal stillness. It remains directly anchored in the focus verb, while repeated branch-backed images of nurture, continuity, and shelter make hidden custodial work coherent. Render as a material analogy for apparent inactivity, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's inventory includes tending or working an estate, permitting a live contrast between visible stillness and invisible maintenance.

activation_trace.role: Working and tending an estate supplies active maintenance concealed beneath the settled exterior.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the kind of work the hidden interval can perform.
Abiding persistence supplies continuity between unseen tending and later visible effects.
Gathering into shelter supplies one concrete outcome of custodial work.

changed_reading.before: The world's stillness at night signals that work has stopped.
changed_reading.after: The still exterior may conceal tending: night is a maintenance interval whose work appears only in repaired and sheltered conditions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the lullaby image comes through a non-dominant split mapping of the guidance root and crosses from cosmic night into child-care. It remains anchored in the focus stilling branch and is supported by orphanhood and merciful shelter. Render as an acoustic-nurturant resonance, explicitly not as a direct sense of the focus verb or the guidance word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb depicts a whole field becoming still, a physical result compatible with being calmed into sleep.

activation_trace.role: Still settling supplies the bodily and environmental quiet produced by calming.
Loss of a caretaker supplies the exposed child-scale condition that makes calming poignant.
Tender mercy supplies the affective quality of the calming motion.
The non-dominant mapped image of rocking a child to sleep supplies the lullaby mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Night's settling is an impersonal cosmic silence.
changed_reading.after: Night can resonate as a vast calming motion, rocking exposed life into a sheltered stillness.

strongest_changes: The daylight cue makes nocturnal settling one phase of an exposure–repose rhythm.
The denied departure and aversion recode silence as held continuity rather than relational withdrawal.
The orphan-to-shelter sequence selects protective canopy over funereal shroud while the anti-domination command makes that canopy non-crushing.
The lack-to-sufficiency sequence activates the rare but packet-explicit reading of still night as a hidden reservoir of provision.
The final movement into renewed speech turns concealment into a phase that leaves later tellable traces.
summary.what_was_special: The focus retained several coexisting mechanics instead of collapsing into one gloss: settling closure, material cover, active nocturnal operation, incubative delay, shelter, guidance within opacity, receptive silence, and hidden yield. The most productive surprises came from letting remote but exact focus branches be activated by later social and material sequences.
remaining_uncertainties: The covering, abundant-yield, non-contact, and estate-tending branches may function only as material analogies rather than live senses in the focus construction.
The ordered context strongly supports temporal and causal arrows, but some links may be juxtaposition rather than the night producing the later reversal.
The lullaby reading depends on a non-dominant mapped root and should remain an acoustic resonance, not lexical disambiguation.
Shelter and shroud remain intentionally co-present; the context strengthens shelter without proving that the darker containment image disappears.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Night as settled cover, not withdrawal.** Evidence: ل ي ل B001 (night opposite day and darkness), س ج و B001 (still settling/closing-in), و د ع B002 in 93:3 (restful ease), ر ب ب B007 in 93:3/5/11 (staying, clinging, lasting). Structural cue: night follows duha and immediately precedes the denial of being left. Mechanism: the packet supplies stillness and later non-abandonment; I supply the reversal that quiet darkness can be protective rest rather than absence. Abductive move: stillness is interpreted through ربّ-continuity as sustained care. Reading change: the ayah reads less like a contrast of light and dark, more like an argument that settled quiet is part of providence.

2. **Shroud-image that raises the abandonment question.** Evidence: س ج و B002 (covering/shrouding with cloth), و د ع B003 in 93:3 (farewell including living or dead person), ق ل ي B003 in 93:3 (aversion casting out of heart). Structural cue: "when it sajā" is adjacent to "has not taken farewell / has not hated." Mechanism: the packet supplies shrouding and farewell branches; I supply the affective fear that a covered-over silence could look like deathlike leave-taking. Abductive move: the verse lets the darkest possible inference surface so 93:3 can negate it. Reading change: night becomes an image of feared abandonment that is then explicitly cancelled.

3. **Untouched food/provision withheld only temporarily.** Evidence: س ج و B004 (not touching/taking food), ض ح و B003 in 93:1 (forenoon meal/grazing), ع ط و B002 and ر ض و B001 in 93:5 (giving and satisfaction). Structural cue: food-related branches flank the night and then resolve in future giving. Mechanism: the packet supplies "not touching food" and later giving; I supply the temporal relation that night pauses access without cancelling provision. Abductive move: interruption of intake is not the same as refusal. Reading change: "when it settles" can be heard as a closed interval before giving, not as deprivation.

4. **Native disposition as calm bearing.** Evidence: س ج و B003 (native disposition/character), ه د ي B010 in 93:7 (calm stillness and composed bearing), ر ض و B001 in 93:5 (acceptance opposed to displeasure). Structural cue: the calm night appears before the addressee is promised satisfaction and described as guided. Mechanism: the packet supplies disposition/calm branches; I supply the interiorization that cosmic stillness models a composure that the addressee will receive. Abductive move: outer night teaches inner steadiness. Reading change: the ayah can be read as forming character, not only describing time.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayat forced a distinction between merciful quiet and harmful silencing. 93:10's لا تنهر made speech ethics central, so the night's س ج و B001 could not be generalized into "silence is always good"; the asker must not be silenced. 93:11 then made speech the final act, turning the night into a temporary cover before disclosure rather than a permanent concealment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Settled night is a pause, not relational cessation.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ل ي ل:B001` supplies night and its darkness, and fixed `س ج و:B001` supplies still settling and closing-in. **Structural cue:** the next ayah negates leaving (`و د ع:B001`) and aversion (`ق ل ي:B003`), while 93:5–7 show giving, shelter, and guidance. **Assigned role:** night supplies sensory non-visibility; the later verbs supply continuing agency despite it. **Abductive move:** the packet gives stillness followed by active care; I infer that lack of perceptible motion ≠ lack of relation. **Reading change:** `سَجَىٰ` becomes a bounded suspension within care rather than evidence that care has ended.

2. **The cover can protect rather than shroud finally.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `س ج و:B002` is covering or shrouding with cloth; 93:6 activates `ء و ي:B001`, drawing into shelter, and 93:7 activates `ض ل ل:B002`, hiddenness, before `ه د ي:B001`, guidance. **Structural cue:** the cover-image is followed by a sheltering reversal and by movement from hiddenness toward direction. **Assigned role:** the covering branch conceals and encloses; shelter determines its protective rather than terminal function. **Abductive move:** the packet also permits the darker shroud image, but I infer cover → protection because the explicit trajectory continues into finding and guidance. **Reading change:** night may be heard as a refuge-like covering whose concealment preserves the covered person for reorientation.

3. **Night remains a traversable medium.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ل ي ل:B002` includes entering or traveling by night; 93:7 supplies loss of location through `ض ل ل:B003` and gentle direction through `ه د ي:B001`. **Structural cue:** a scene of still night is eventually paired with a lost/found directional correction. **Assigned role:** the night branch supplies the medium of passage, while guidance supplies course. **Abductive move:** I infer that environmental stillness can coexist with the addressee's passage through uncertainty; the packet supplies no literal journey. **Reading change:** the oath can frame darkness as an interval navigated under guidance, not merely endured in immobility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 93:6 corrected the potentially terminal shroud-image of `س ج و:B002`: later shelter made protective covering more coherent than final closure. Then 93:7 activated `ل ي ل:B002` unexpectedly by pairing loss of location with guidance, making the settled night a medium through which direction can still be recovered.

findings.text: Çöken gecenin dinginliği, ilişkinin kesilmesi değil, görünür hareket olmadan da bakımın sürdüğü sınırlı bir duraklama olarak belirginleşir.
Örtü çağrışımı önce son bir kefen gibi algılanabilse de sonraki barındırma ve yol gösterme, onu koruyan ve yeniden yönelmeye hazırlayan bir örtüye dönüştürür.
Geceleyin yol alma boyutu, karanlığı yalnız beklenen değil, yönün yeniden bulunabildiği bir geçiş ortamı yapar.
Yemeğe el sürmeme çağrışımı, geceyi rızkın reddi değil, sonraki verişten önce erişimin geçici olarak durduğu bir aralık gibi düşündürür.
Gecenin doğuştan huy ve karakter çağrışımı, dış dinginliği yol gösterilmeyle kazanılan iç sükunete örnek saymayı önerir; bu kişilik aktarımı oldukça dolaylıdır.

concept_map.definition: Gündüzün karşıtı olan gece zamanı ve bu zamana özgü karanlıktır. Belirli söz öbekleri, temel anlamı değiştirmeden gecenin çok karanlık, çetin ya da uzun oluşunu veya ayın en karanlık son gecesini belirtir.

facets.statement: Gündüzün karşıtı olan zaman bölümü gecedir; tek bir gece veya birden çok gece olarak sayılabilir.
Gece adı, bu zaman bölümüne özgü karanlığı da anlatabilir.
Belirli niteleme kalıpları çok karanlık veya çetin bir geceyi anlatır.
Bir başka pekiştirme kalıbı gecenin uzunluğunu veya şiddetini özellikle öne çıkarır.
Özel bir söz öbeği, ayın hem en karanlık hem de son gecesini belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, genel gece türünü değil konuşma gününe en yakın geceyi seçen bağlamsal bir kullanımı açıkça tanımlar. Gündüz konuşulurken girilecek geceye yönelim ile günün ilk yarısında tamamlanmış bir eylemin önceki geceye bağlanması, geçici çerçevede belirtilen yakınlık ve söyleme zamanı sınırını doğrular.

Tamamlanmış bir eylem günün ilk yarısında anlatılırken ifade önceki geceye dönebilir; gün ilerleyince geçmiş gece için başka bir zaman sözü seçilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız ad olarak kullanılan biçimi ve şarabı anan tam söz öbeğini kapsar; bunlar genel gece veya karanlık anlamına genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir biçimin kadın adı olarak kullanılmasıdır; aynı adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeği ise şarabı anan örtülü bir ad işlevi görür. İki kullanım aynı dalda bulunsa da kadın adı ile içki anlamı birbirine eşit değildir.

facets.statement: Söz konusu biçim bir kadını adlandıran kişi adı olarak kullanılır.
Bu adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeği, şarabı doğrudan söylemeden anan örtülü bir ad olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt kadın adı kullanımını ortak biçimde destekler ve ayrıca bu adı içeren tam bir söz öbeğinin şarabı örten bir ad olduğunu bildirir. İkinci kullanım bağımsız söz öbeğine bağlı tutulmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, anlam çekirdeğini hareketin dinmesi ve ortaya çıkan durumun sürmesi olarak verir. Gece, deniz, rüzgâr ve bakışla ilgili kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; gecenin kararması ise yalnız gece bağlamına bağlı bir özelliktir.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin dinmesi ve oluşan durgun durumun sürmesidir; gece söz konusu olduğunda buna karanlığın çöküp yerleşmesi de eşlik edebilir.

facets.statement: Hareket diner ve ortaya çıkan durgunluk bir süre devam eder.
Gece, durulup uzaması yanında kararıp çökmüş bir halde anlatılabilir.
Denizdeki gerçekleşme, dalgaların dinip denizin durgunlaşmasıdır.
Rüzgârdaki gerçekleşme, esişin kesilip havanın sakinleşmesidir.
Göz ve bakışta durgun, gevşek ve süzgün bir görünüşü belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili söz, dişi devenin sütünün bol gelmesini açıkça belirtir ve kuyu kullanımını aynı cümlede buna bağlar. Ancak kuyuda neyin bollaştığını tek başına açıklamaz; bu yüzden dal korunurken açık süt bolluğu çekirdek, kuyu ise nesnesi belirtilmemiş kaynak çeşitlemesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Devenin süt bolluğu açıktır; kuyu kullanımında bolluğun neye ait olduğu açıklanmadığından su bolluğu kesin anlam diye yazılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Deveye bağlı açık kullanım ile açıklama bekleyen kuyu biçimi ayrı tutulur; ikisinden çıplak köke genel bir bolluk anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dişi devenin sütünün bol gelmesidir; aynı kaynakta kuyuya bağlanan kullanım da vardır, ancak kuyuda neyin bol olduğu ayrıca açıklanmaz.

facets.statement: Dişi deve, sütünün bol gelmesiyle nitelenir.
Aynı biçim kuyu için de kullanılır, fakat kuyuyla ilgili bolluğun nesnesi belirtilmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek tanıklık deve sütündeki bolluğu açıkça verir ve kuyu kullanımını buna koşut biçimde anar; kuyudaki bolluğun nesnesini ayrıca tanımlamaz.

source_details.summary: Tek kayıt, deve sütü bolluğunu açıklar; kuyuya uygulanan aynı biçimin tam kapsamını ise açık bırakır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın açıkça tanımlanan deve ve süt çekirdeği için kullanılır; kuyu çeşitlemesini tek başına karşılamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Dişi deveyi ve sütünün bol gelmesi anlamını eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Kuyuya bağlanan, ancak tam nesnesi açıklanmayan kaynak çeşitlemesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişi devenin süt veriminin bol hale geldiği cümlelerde doğal fiil karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Sütün azlıktan bolluğa geçmesi anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kuyuya bağlanan belirsiz kaynak çeşitlemesini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kuyuya bağlanan kullanım açıklanırken ve neyin bollaştığının belirtilmediği açıkça korunurken kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyuya bağlı bolluk yönünü ve anlatımdaki belirsizliği korur.
error_profile.loses: Devenin süt bolluğunu ve bu anlamın açık nesnesini dışarıda bırakır.
